But relay()'s task text, which the clerk also reads, still says with no limit 'If it prints no JSON, return <empty> with error'. On a moved call the clerk therefore again gets two instructions that disagree. PR4C-13 says a moved call does not trigger the rule, which is true of the clerk file only. The corrector's claim that relay's second attempt recovers the error is false: relay retries only on a null return (`if (r) return r`). The case is rare, because relay commands carry no --wait and the default wait of 100 s is well inside the 600000 ms timeout.
still_open.proposed_fix: Either B4a's relay text (spec and prelude.js) limits its no-JSON sentence to a finished call and adds M3's background sentence (left-for-builder, B4a).
